gaps.sentence: Who ___ this bag belong to? It has been sitting here all morning.
gaps.hint: the question form needs auxiliary does
gaps.explanation: Present simple questions need the auxiliary 'does' plus the base verb: does this bag belong to.

gaps.sentence: No sooner ___ the verdict been read than the defence announced an appeal.
gaps.explanation: 'No sooner had … been read than' — past perfect passive with inversion.

gaps.sentence: When I was a boy, films ___ in black and white.
gaps.hint: a past state no longer existing
gaps.explanation: 'Used to be' describes a past state that has ended: used to be.

gaps.sentence: Water ___ at 100 degrees Celsius at sea level.
gaps.hint: a timeless scientific fact takes present simple
gaps.explanation: General truths and scientific facts take the present simple: boils.

gaps.sentence: This time next week I ___ across the desert.
gaps.hint: action in progress at a future time
gaps.explanation: 'This time next week' — future continuous for an ongoing future action.

gaps.sentence: While I ___ the report yesterday, my laptop battery died.
gaps.hint: the battery died interrupted the writing
gaps.explanation: The dying battery interrupted the ongoing writing, so the past continuous fits: was writing.

gaps.sentence: She ___ her ankle as she was getting off the bus.
gaps.hint: a sudden event during a longer action
gaps.explanation: A short, sudden action interrupting a longer one takes the past simple: twisted.

gaps.sentence: I ___ you were in hospital — why did nobody tell me?
gaps.explanation: The finding out is in the past, so the past simple 'didn't know' is used.
